dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Oh, is that so? Oh dear.

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'm not sure how I can help her. I've given it some thought, though — if all else fails, I can play the role of the fish myself...

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: But that's not really a solution I'd call "good," so... Could you try helping her?
